title: Integer overflow in length field leads to undersized allocation
description: In the binary protocol parser parse_frame() in src/proto/frame.c, the 32-bit length field is multiplied by the element size with no overflow check, then passed to malloc. A crafted length wraps the multiplication, a small buffer is allocated, and the following copy writes past it. Heap overflow reachable from network input.
poc_text: Send a frame whose length field is 0x40000001 against a build with 32-bit size_t.
